prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, hip-cut demi statue portrait, a 20-cell crystal-only grid body (10 rows, two columns), every cell physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh-stub tips just below her hip line, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman in yamanba makeup — a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, wide stark-white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and turquoise eyeshadow, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small star and heart rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, long teased neon pink and lime hair, a bold cheeky grin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big neon-acrylic hoop and a small silver star stud.

Physique: A colossal heavy chest, a cinched waist above a big soft rounded belly and enormous round hips, body divided into a 20-cell grid (10 rows, two columns), each cell a different crystal variant, stepped seams.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Below the collarbones, her body is divided into a grid of 20 cells — 10 horizontal rows stacked top to bottom, crossed by one vertical line down the centre splitting each row into a left and right cell — each cell with a raised stepped edge and shadow at every border, no gaps, no skin anywhere, every cell a genuinely different variant of the same crystal material family. Row 1 (her whole left arm and left chest / her whole right arm and right chest): left cell solid transparent golden-yellow citrine crystal; right cell solid transparent deep blue sapphire crystal. Row 2 (left / right body band 2): left cell solid transparent deep ruby-red cast glass; right cell solid transparent clear sea-blue aquamarine crystal. Row 3 (left / right body band 3): left cell solid transparent deep cobalt-blue cast glass; right cell solid transparent amethyst crystal. Row 4 (left / right body band 4): left cell solid transparent soft pink rose quartz; right cell solid transparent milky moonstone. Row 5 (left / right body band 5): left cell solid transparent milky precious opal; right cell solid transparent orange-red carnelian. Row 6 (left / right body band 6): left cell solid transparent deep green emerald crystal; right cell solid transparent deep green jade. Row 7 (left / right body band 7): left cell solid transparent translucent alabaster; right cell solid transparent glacial ice. Row 8 (left / right body band 8): left cell solid transparent Murano glass; right cell solid transparent water-clear casting resin. Row 9 (left / right body band 9): left cell solid transparent weathered sea glass; right cell solid transparent smoky black cast glass. Row 10 (left thigh-stub tip / right thigh-stub tip): left cell solid transparent clear emerald-green cast glass, rounding off at its tip; right cell solid transparent milky frosted glass, rounding off at its tip.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm golden amber on one side and a deep charcoal grey on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so amber light glances off one side and grey light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam in the grid. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
